prompt:
Generate one 4:3 landscape image.
Style reference: artwork/illustrations/reference/paper-town-style-v1.png (MaiPace "Phố giấy" style).
Style description: Traditional watercolor and gouache painting on warm pale ivory paper, fine expressive dark pencil outlines, softened hand-painted shapes, subtle natural paper grain texture INSIDE painted shapes. Restrained color palette of warm ivory, sand, beige, charcoal gray/black, sage/olive green, and occasional muted brick-red. Friendly, warm editorial storybook illustration, peaceful Japanese everyday aesthetic. NOT glossy 3D, NOT photorealistic, NOT flat vector icon, NOT thick cartoon anime lines, NOT digital gradients.

Characters:
- The two young learners:
  1. Male student: short slightly messy dark hair, wearing an ivory long-sleeved shirt, charcoal trousers, dark backpack.
  2. Young woman: dark bob haircut with straight bangs, cream/ivory cardigan over a brick-red top, charcoal skirt, brown shoulder bag.
- Japanese department store clerk / guide: wearing a neat dark uniform or vest, gesturing politely with an open hand to guide the two visitors through the department floor.
All characters have natural human anatomy, well-drawn hands and faces with polite, gentle, friendly expressions.

Scene content:
- Inside a spacious, calm, elegant Japanese department store floor (depaato) with light wood pillars, warm ambient glow, and warm ivory paper background.
- In the background: an escalator leading up to another level (clean architectural lines, no signs).
- In the midground and sides: neat wooden and glass display counters featuring items like arranged ties, leather shoes, or wine bottles in simple painted silhouettes without any labels or price tags.
- The two students and the store clerk are centrally placed and clearly legible even at small thumbnail size.
- Opaque warm ivory paper background filling the frame.

Strict Negative Constraints:
- Absolutely NO text, NO letters, NO numbers, NO digits, NO Japanese characters (no kana, no kanji), NO floor signs, NO department signs, NO price tags, NO brand logos, NO watermarks, NO UI elements, NO speech bubbles. All signs, directory boards, and product labels must be completely blank or omitted.
- Absolutely NO fake checkerboard transparency pattern. Background must be solid opaque warm ivory paper.
- Aspect ratio: 4:3 (landscape).
